content.short: Global accounts, cards, invoicing and USDC/USDT receipts.
content.description: Raenest, formerly Geegpay, is an African fintech that helps freelancers, remote workers, and businesses receive, hold, and spend money globally. Its platform provides multi-currency accounts with USD, GBP, and EUR details, virtual and physical cards, invoicing, and the ability to receive stablecoin payments in USDC and USDT over networks such as Ethereum and Tron, then convert to local currency. With hundreds of thousands of users, Raenest focuses on Africans earning from international clients who struggle with limited access to foreign accounts and expensive conversions. By combining global accounts, cards, invoicing, and stablecoin receipts in one profitable, fast-growing platform, Raenest positions itself as a global money partner for the continent's freelancers, remote workers, and cross-border businesses.
content.meta: Raenest offers global accounts, cards, and stablecoin receipts for African freelancers. Discover Raenest and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
